# MeatCity

> Meat that matters.

MeatCity is a fresh meat retail and home-delivery business based in Turbhe, Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra, India. We specialize in fresh, hygienic, and 100% halal meat supply, offering farm-fresh chicken, tender goat mutton, fresh farm eggs, and seafood to residential households and commercial wholesale partners.

## Business Details

- **Official Website**: https://meatcity.in/
- **Business Type**: Fresh chicken, fresh mutton, and eggs retail and delivery
- **Positioning**: Fresh, hygienic, halal meat supply
- **Tagline**: Meat that matters
- **FSSAI License**: Reg No. 21525016001365 (Valid Till: 12-11-2026)
- **Primary Service Area**: Turbhe, Sector 20, and surrounding localities in Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra, India
- **Shop Address**: A/2 Room No.126, Shop No.2, Sector 20, Turbhe, Navi Mumbai - 400705, Maharashtra, India
- **Contact Phone**: +91 7977630912
- **WhatsApp**: https://wa.me/917977630912

## Core Product Offerings

Browse live availability and cuts on the official storefront:

- **Fresh Chicken**: Curry cuts, boneless breast, whole chicken, and specialty cuts
- **Fresh Mutton**: Tender goat mutton curry cut, keema (minced mutton), and bone-in portions
- **Eggs**: Fresh farm eggs (packs of 6, 12, and 30)
- **Seafood & Fish**: Cleaned, descaled seasonal fish selections
- **Ready to Cook**: Freshly marinated cuts and tikka mixes

## Ordering & Fulfillment

- **Ordering Method**: Place orders directly through the website shopping cart and checkout at https://meatcity.in/
- **Delivery Options**: Express delivery and scheduled delivery (subject to serviceable pincodes and operational availability)
- **Pricing & Stock**: Real-time pricing and stock availability are maintained on the website catalog; please refer to the live website for current rates
- **Payment Methods**: Cash on Delivery (COD), UPI, Debit Cards, and Credit Cards
